thread:
Sam (AcmeWidgets): Hey @Alex - we're seeing a regression in our invoice summarizer right after yesterday's rollout. Filed ticket: https://support.redwood.ai/t/12345 - example: our template uses a {{total_amount}} placeholder and now sometimes it returns 'N/A' instead of the amount.
Alex - Support: Thanks Sam — linking this in. Can you paste a minimal repro prompt + the exact API request you used? Also which model did you hit (model name in the response headers)?
Sam (AcmeWidgets): Repro below. This used model rw-instruct-v3. Request ID in our logs: req_8f3b2a. Notice the placeholder has a trailing space in some templates.

``` 
POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx
Content-Type: application/json

{"model":"rw-instruct-v3","prompt":"Summarize invoice:\nInvoice total: {{total_amount}}\nItems: {{items}}\n--","temperature":0}
```

Response (before rollout):
"Invoice total: $1,234.56"

Response (after rollout):
"Invoice total: N/A"

Alex - Support: Got it. Quick triage: is this consistently reproducible for you or intermittent? Any template variants that still work?
Sam (AcmeWidgets): Consistent on some customers' PDFs. It looks like when the template engine left a trailing space inside the placeholder it breaks. Minimal: `{{total_amount}}` -> works, `{{total_amount}} ` -> breaks.
Maria (Eng): Jumping in. Thanks for the repro and request id. I see the deploy-bot completed a rollout to rw-instruct-v3-canary -> rw-instruct-v3 main yesterday around 22:05 UTC. @deploy-bot any notes about tokenizer/regression flags?
deploy-bot: Completed rollout rw-instruct-v3 (canary->prod) at 2024-11-21T22:05:12Z. No rollback triggered. Release notes: minor tokenizer normalization fixes, kernel swap for q4 quantized path.
Maria (Eng): That kernel/quant change is suspicious — we changed the Unicode normalization step in tokenization to fold certain U+00A0/non-breaking spaces and adjust brace handling to match open-source tokenizer updates. That can affect token boundaries for templates with trailing spaces.
Jin - ProdOps: For customers affected, we can pin them to rw-instruct-v2 (previous model) temporarily while eng investigates. Do we have a quick exploit or mitigation? 
Maria (Eng): Two options:
1) Server-side patch: add a lightweight pre-normalization step that collapses trailing spaces inside double-brace placeholders before tokenization (hotpatch). Low-risk.
2) Rollback model -> previous variant (rw-instruct-v2) for impacted accounts. Safer and faster for P0 customers.

Alex - Support: Sam, can you confirm whether you can tolerate a short rollback for your account? If yes we can pin you to v2 immediately.
Sam (AcmeWidgets): Yes please pin to v2 for now. This is breaking billing downstream.

Maria (Eng): In the meantime, can you also try this client-side quick check? Trim any trailing space inside braces before sending to the API. Example JS snippet:

```
const fixedPrompt = prompt.replace(/\{\{\s*(.*?)\s*\}\}/g, '{{$1}}');
```

Alex - Support: Adding reproduction logs from req_8f3b2a: tokenization trace shows before rollout tokens: ["Invoice"," total"," :"," $","1","234",".","56"] and after rollout: ["Invoice"," total"," :"," N","/","A"] — suggests different normalization produced an extra tokenization split for the numeric group.
Maria (Eng): Agreed. We're opening an internal bug (INF-6421) to track: root cause likely the tokenizer normalization + quantized kernel path interacting for brace-adjacent spaces. I'll add a test in the eval suite for placeholder-edge whitespace.
Jin - ProdOps: Action items: 1) Pin Sam (AcmeWidgets) to rw-instruct-v2 (done) 2) Push hotpatch to pre-normalize templates in the serving layer for all customers as a temporary mitigation 3) Roll forward fix or more conservative tokenizer update in next canary.

Alex - Support: Sam — I've pinned your account and confirmed the invoice summarizer output returned to correct values for the reported examples. Can you verify on your end?
Sam (AcmeWidgets): Confirmed — reverted to expected behaviour. Thanks for the quick turnaround. Can you keep me posted on permanent fix timeline?
Maria (Eng): We'll aim to have a hotpatch out in the next 2 hours and a full test+release in the next canary (24–48 hours). INF-6421 will have updates. @Jin please schedule the hotpatch.
Jin - ProdOps: Hotpatch scheduled and will apply a light pre-normalization hook across the inference frontends in the next maintenance window (30m). I'll update INF-6421 with rollout notes.
Alex - Support: Closing loop with the customer. Sam, I'll leave the thread open until the final fix is deployed. Thanks team :thumbsup:
Sam (AcmeWidgets): Thanks everyone :raised_hands: Appreciated the fast response.
